messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — I'm refreshing the GreetApp quickstart to match the new SDK v4 auth pattern and to simplify the first deploy step. PR open: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Can someone triage the snippets?

tara: thanks — can you call out which snippets changed? I can run a local smoke test.

morgan: main changes: move from `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var in examples to `REDWOOD_KEY` runtime pattern, update python snippet to use `from redwood import Redwood` + `client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])` instead of old helper. Also swap the deploy command to `rwd deploy --env dev` (new CLI).

leon: quick question: do we need to keep the old `REDWOOD_API_KEY` mention anywhere for backward compat? some customers still on older SDK.

morgan: good call — plan is: keep a short migration note at the top of the quickstart and add a tiny section "If you're on SDK v3" with the legacy snippet. want to avoid confusion in the main path.

sanjay: local smoke test results: python snippet boots, but the streaming example throws `AttributeError: 'Redwood' object has no attribute 'stream'` — looks like the method name changed.

morgan: ah — updated method is `stream_generate`. I'll patch that. thanks.

tara: I ran the CLI deploy step on mac and saw an auth failure: `401 Unauthorized`. I had the env var set but with wrong key name. Should we make the error message in docs clearer? like `export REDWOOD_KEY=...` and verify with `rwd whoami`?

morgan: yes, adding a troubleshooting line and `rwd whoami` example is on my TODO.

leon: small nit: the config snippet currently shows `region: us-east` but our standard is `us-east-1`. PR should update that to avoid confusion.

morgan: fixed in a followup commit.

docs-bot: Deploy check triggered for branch docs/greetapp-auth-refresh by morgan — status: pending.

morgan: tagging @tara and @leon for final review on the snippets and the migration note. Also added a short link to the auth migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth/migration-v3-to-v4

tara: LGTM on content, one wording suggestion on the migration note. I'll push a tiny commit to rephrase.

sanjay: verified streaming rename fix locally. suggest adding a one-line example showing `async for chunk in client.stream_generate(...)` so it's explicit.

morgan: done — added the async iteration example and a small code fence.

leon: ok to merge once docs-bot shows green and CI lint passes.

docs-bot: CI lint: passed. link-checker: failed — 1 broken link (old auth guide URL).

morgan: thanks — updating the link to the canonical auth page now.

morgan: updated. pinging again for merge.

tara: :thumbsup: merging after CI.

docs-bot: PR merged by tara into main at 1987654379.

morgan: thanks all! I'll watch the quickstart page for any follow-up feedback.
